page_title: LEC 1-1 VEN | Lecce v Venezia 06/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the right post.
90+4' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) sends a cross into the box, but Wladimiro Falcone comes off his line to gather the ball.
90+3' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
90+3' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Now Venezia have a corner.
90+2' Nikola Krstovic finds Medon Berisha (Lecce) unmarked on the edge of the box, but his thunderbolt of shot goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Venezia.
90+1' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) produces a cross from the resulting free kick far from the goal, but there's no one to really attack the ball and the goalkeeper gathers easily.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Marco Piccinini blows his whistle after Issa Doumbia (Venezia) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
89' Surely that's handball by one of the Venezia players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
88' Venezia can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
88' Venezia play a few nice passes from player to player, but their possession doesn't last long as an opposition player intercepts a pass. Venezia have been awarded a corner kick.
86' The linesman raises his flag. Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) is adjudged offside.
85' Issa Doumbia (Venezia) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
84' A cross into the box finds the head of Kialonda Gaspar (Lecce) who steers it goalwards, but Ionut Radu manages to pull off a decent save to thwart him.
84' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the mid-range attempt from the free-kick by Medon Berisha (Lecce).
83' Fali Cande (Venezia) tackles a bit over-zealously and Marco Piccinini blows for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Lecce. Fali Cande (Venezia) receives a yellow card.
83' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
81' Issa Doumbia (Venezia) makes a rough challenge and Marco Piccinini blows his whistle for a foul.
81' Kike Perez will be replaced by Issa Doumbia (Venezia).

80' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
79' Konan Ndri (Lecce) storms into the box to get on the end of a pass, but smashes his shot straight onto the right post. Unlucky!
78' Fali Cande (Venezia) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Marco Piccinini blows his whistle for a foul.
78' Kike Perez (Venezia) has time on the edge of the box. His shot is disappointing, though, as it flies towards the middle of the goal where Wladimiro Falcone makes a comfortable save.
77' Konan Ndri (Lecce) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
76' Medon Berisha (Lecce) misses the target from a promising position, sending the ball well wide of the left post.
73' The referee signals a substitution. Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Venezia) is brought on as a substitute for Alessandro Marcandalli.
72' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
72' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
69' Lecce take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

69' The game is pretty dull as Lecce are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball. Lecce force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
68' Marco Giampaolo prepares a substitution. Frederic Guilbert is replaced by Danilo Veiga (Lecce).
68' Eusebio Di Francesco decides to make a substitution. Christian Gytkjaer will be replaced by Daniel Fila (Venezia).
68' Substitution. John Yeboah makes way for Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia).

65' 1 - 1 Goal! The ball is swung into the box from the resulting corner kick and finds Federico Baschirotto (Lecce), who jumps highest and tries his luck with a header from around the penalty spot. His effort is both strong and precise enough to go into the bottom right corner. The score changes to 1:1.
65' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) will take a corner kick.
65' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. Lecce have a corner.
64' Marco Piccinini shows the yellow card to Kike Perez (Venezia) for a heavy challenge.
63' He should have done better. Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) is afforded space to connect with a Thorir Johann Helgason cross, but his header from the centre of the box flies well over the crossbar.
63' Konan Ndri (Lecce) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
62' Konan Ndri (Lecce) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Corner kick. Lecce will have an opportunity.
61' Marco Piccinini shows a yellow card to Frederic Guilbert (Lecce) for a tough tackle.
60' Frederic Guilbert (Lecce) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
57' Tete Morente (Lecce) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
55' The foul by Alessandro Marcandalli (Venezia) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Marco Piccinini.
54' Here is a change. Santiago Pierotti is going off and Marco Giampaolo gives the last tactical orders to Konan Ndri (Lecce).
54' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Balthazar Pierret (Lecce) replaces Lassana Coulibaly.
54' Substitution. Medon Berisha (Lecce) replaces Ylber Ramadani.
53' The possession of the ball – 45:55.
50' 0 - 1 OWN GOAL! The free kick is whipped in and the ball hits Antonino Gallo (Lecce), who finds the back of his own net. 0:1.
48' A pass by Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

47' Christian Gytkjaer (Venezia) expertly wins the ball from the free kick, but his effort from the edge of the penalty area isn't accurate at all and the ball goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
47' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
46' A yellow card for a tackle by Federico Baschirotto (Lecce). Marco Piccinini doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
46' The manager makes a subsitution with Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia) coming on for Franco Carboni.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.

45' Tete Morente (Lecce) evades challenges and shoots from the edge of the box. It's a good effort, but flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Venezia.
45' PENALTY APPEAL after John Yeboah (Venezia) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
44' Tete Morente (Lecce) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
42' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The linesman signals a throw-in for Venezia.
41' John Yeboah (Venezia) wastes a big chance! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box and it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
40' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
39' Marco Piccinini shows a yellow card to Franco Carboni (Venezia), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
39' An attempted cross from Frederic Guilbert (Lecce) is cleared. Lecce have been awarded a corner kick.
38' 9:6 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
37' Kike Perez (Venezia) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
36' Kike Perez (Venezia) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
35' Tete Morente (Lecce) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player.
34' Franco Carboni (Venezia) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
33' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
33' Marco Piccinini blows his whistle. Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) commits a foul after dangerous play.
32' Christian Gytkjaer (Venezia) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.

31' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) has a great chance on the edge of the six-yard box following a lofted pass, but his header lacks accuracy and flies just past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.
29' Marco Piccinini has a clear sight and sees a foul from Frederic Guilbert (Lecce).

27' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) spurns a big chance! He makes himself some space to meet a cross and from near the penalty spot sends a header well wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Venezia.
26' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.

25' Kike Perez (Venezia) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Wladimiro Falcone pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
24' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Ionut Radu.

23' Alessandro Marcandalli (Venezia) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Lecce are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
22' The linesman signals that Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
22' The resulting corner from Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) comes to nothing.
22' The resulting corner from Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger. It will be a corner kick for Lecce.

21' Federico Baschirotto (Lecce) receives a nice pass from the free kick and strikes from the edge of the box, but his attempt hits one of the defenders and bounces away off him. The linesman makes the right call and Lecce will have a corner.
20' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
20' Marco Piccinini blows his whistle for a foul after Gianluca Busio (Venezia) hacks down one of his opponents.
19' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
18' A cross from the corner kick arrives at the feet of John Yeboah (Venezia), giving him an opportunity to shoot. He misses completely, way over the bar.
18' Kike Perez (Venezia) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
17' John Yeboah (Venezia) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. Venezia will take a corner kick.
17' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
16' Tete Morente (Lecce) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Lecce will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
15' Tete Morente (Lecce) strikes a bullet of a shot towards goal from distance and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
15' The offside statistics – 4:0.
14' Flag goes up against Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
13' Kike Perez (Venezia) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
12' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

12' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Santiago Pierotti (Lecce). Lecce have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
10' The flag is raised and Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) is offside again, not for the first time today.
9' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
7' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Nikola Krstovic (Lecce).
6' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
4' Flag up against Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
4' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.

3' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. The ball is behind the touchline and Lecce will take a throw-in.
1' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Lecce will kick the game off.
Marco Piccinini got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
